level_description: Local Refinements & Scalar Constraints (Single-field bounds, exact literals, set memberships, and primitive boolean flags with zero cross-field arithmetic)

L1_user_onboarding.name: User Account Onboarding & Compliance
L1_user_onboarding.description: Validates integer scalar boundaries, string enumeration membership, and mandatory boolean flags without cross-field dependencies.

prompts.system: You are a backend identity verification service configuring user account profiles. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a compliant user onboarding record for an adult customer residing in a supported jurisdiction.

age.description: User age in years (must be between 18 and 120)

terms_accepted.description: Terms of service acknowledgement (must be true)

L1_iot_telemetry.name: Industrial IoT Sensor Telemetry
L1_iot_telemetry.description: Enforces physical sensor reading boundaries on floating-point and integer metrics along with status categorization.

prompts.system: You are an edge device transmitting telemetry packets from an industrial environmental monitor. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Emit an active sensor packet reporting current environmental metrics within standard operational limits.

temperature_c.description: Ambient temperature in Celsius (must be between -40.0 and 85.0)

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity percentage (must be between 0.0 and 100.0)

battery_level.description: Remaining battery percentage (must be between 0 and 100)

L1_network_security_rule.name: Cloud VPC Security Group Rule
L1_network_security_rule.description: Tests adherence to network protocol types, standard TCP/UDP port ranges, and priority ordering without cross-field arithmetic.

prompts.system: You are a cloud infrastructure controller provisioning firewall rules for an enterprise VPC. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Define an enabled security group rule permitting valid inbound traffic on a standard port range.

rule_name.description: Human-readable name for the firewall rule

port.description: Target port number (must be between 1 and 65535)
